subject: Re: Your Quillmoss PR box is on its way

messages.body:
Hi Saoirse,

Thanks for filling in the seeding form. Your Barrier Reset box left our Rotterdam warehouse today:

- Dew Barrier Serum 30 ml
- Cloudmilk Cleanser 150 ml
- Veil Skin Tint SPF 30 in 04 Honey and 05 Golden (the two shades you picked)

Tracking: https://track.quillmoss.example/QM-EU-48213

No strings at all - it's yours to try. If you ever do share it, just label it as gifted.

Thanks so much,
Imogen
messages.subject: Your Quillmoss PR box is on its way

messages.body:
Hi Imogen,

The box arrived on Thursday, thank you so much, the packaging is gorgeous! I've been using the serum every morning.

Two things though - there was only one tint in there (04 Honey), no sign of the Golden one. Is it coming separately? Honey is a bit light on me at the moment so Golden is the one I really wanted to try.

And I hope this isn't cheeky, but is there any chance of getting the bigger 50ml serum instead of the little one? I go through serum so fast and I'd love to give it a proper go before I talk about it.

Also - is there a date you'd like me to post by? Happy to do a GRWM with it.

Saoirse x
